name: 笑脸 smiley-tread road tire

origin.basis: Innova Rubber Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 in Changhua, Taiwan (retailer company profile).

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Low-cost folding road tire with a smiley-face tread and colour edges, sold widely in China.
weight_basis: One owner reported 240 g for a 28C.

availability.note: Sold in mainland China by a Tmall Maxxis dealer and many Taobao shops; other regions not verified.

price_observations.market: 玛吉斯赛力专卖店 (Tmall dealer)
price_observations.conditions: Dealer list price for one pink-edge 28C tire before discounts; coupon price CNY 142.

caveats: Exact English model name and size-specific specifications were not found.
Owner grip rating was the lowest in its comparison group.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model and, where the model is sold in more than one construction, say which; seller replies, questions, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out.

reports.summary: In an uncontrolled five-tire comparison it tied for second in rolling but came last for grip.
Punctured twice in one day by small stones and showed many cracks after under 1,000 km in less than a year.
A rear fitted in 2019 lasted about six years of on-off use before its sidewall came apart, still riding 30 km home; the owner then ordered the 3029.

checks.note: Four posts; an unexplained insult is not counted
